name: Starhill Global Real Estate Investment Trust
summary: Starhill Global Real Estate Investment Trust is a Singapore-based real estate investment trust investing primarily in real estate used for retail and office purposes, both in Singapore and overseas. Starhill Global REIT has grown its initial portfolio from interests in two landmark properties on Orchard Road in Singapore to eight properties in Singapore, Australia, Malaysia and China, valued at about S2.7 billion dollars. These comprise interests in Wisma Atria and Ngee Ann City on Orchard Road in Singapore, Myer Centre Adelaide, David Jones Building and Plaza Arcade in Adelaide and Perth, Australia, The Starhill and Lot 10 Property in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia; and a property in Chengdu, China…
